test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: With which of the following states is the folk dance Tarangmel associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tarangmel__ is the folk dance of Goa that celebrates the **youthfulness of the region.**
 
• It is performed during Dussehra and Holi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• There are eight classical dances recognized by the Government of India
 
• **These are Bharatnatyam, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Mohiniyattam, Kathak, Manipuri, Odissi, and Sattriya.**
